sql: select tag, count(*) as open_now from (select lo.ticker, split_part(lo.strategy,'-',1) as tag from live_orders lo where lo.action='buy' and lo.status in ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled')) x join lateral (select p.position from positions p where p.ticker = x.ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) pos on true where pos.position <> 0 group by tag order by tag
